vjimc-2018-cat1-01.prompt: Every point of the rectangle $R=[0,4]\times[0,40]$ is coloured using one of four colours. Show that there exist four points in $R$ with the same colour that form a rectangle having integer side lengths.
vjimc-2018-cat1-01.answer: Pigeonhole on the $41$ rows $\{(k,j):k=0,\dots,4\}$, $j=0,\dots,40$. Each row has a monochromatic pair; there are only $4\cdot\binom52=40$ possible (colour, pair) types, so two rows share one.

vjimc-2018-cat1-02.prompt:
Find all prime numbers $p$ such that $p^3$ divides the determinant
$$\begin{vmatrix}2^2&1&1&\cdots&1\\1&3^2&1&\cdots&1\\1&1&4^2&&1\\\vdots&\vdots&&\ddots&\\1&1&1&&(p+7)^2\end{vmatrix}.$$

vjimc-2018-cat1-03.prompt:
Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $x_1,\dots,x_n$ be positive real numbers satisfying $|x_i-x_j|\le1$ for all pairs $(i,j)$ with $1\le i<j\le n$. Prove that
$$\frac{x_1}{x_2}+\frac{x_2}{x_3}+\dots+\frac{x_{n-1}}{x_n}+\frac{x_n}{x_1}\ge\frac{x_2+1}{x_1+1}+\frac{x_3+1}{x_2+1}+\dots+\frac{x_n+1}{x_{n-1}+1}+\frac{x_1+1}{x_n+1}.$$
vjimc-2018-cat1-03.answer: With $h(t)=t-\ln t$, show $h\big(\frac xy\big)\ge h\big(\frac{y+1}{x+1}\big)$ whenever $|x-y|\le1$, and sum cyclically; the logarithms telescope to $0$.

vjimc-2018-cat1-04.prompt:
Determine all possible (finite or infinite) values of
$$\lim_{x\to-\infty}f(x)-\lim_{x\to+\infty}f(x),$$
if $f\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is a strictly decreasing continuous function satisfying
$$f(f(x))^4-f(f(x))+f(x)=1$$
for all $x\in\mathbb R$.
vjimc-2018-cat1-04.answer: Exactly the numbers in the open interval $\big(0,(1+z)^4-1\big)$, where $z=\frac{3}{4\sqrt[3]4}$ (so $(1+z)^4-1\approx3.701$); infinite values are impossible.
